messages:
Aisha Patel: quick thought — our CS notes are super long, and PMs can't quickly extract feature asks. propose a tiny 'customer nugget' template for CS to use when they surface product feedback. keep it 3 lines max.
Tom Nguyen: yes please. long threads = ignored. can you sketch the template? :pray:
Aisha Patel: sketch below — use as copy-paste in the note or a short thread reply.
```
Customer Nugget
- Short description (one sentence)
- Customer impact / #customers affected (quantify if possible)
- Ask (specific feature request or blocker) + urgency (low/med/high)
```
Ravi Kapoor: love it. add a quick RICE-ish score line? even 0-5 impact helps triage. example: Impact 4 / Effort 2.
Maya Lopez: tagging for onboarding flows would help — add suggested tags like: onboarding, renewal-risk, integrations, perf. we run 2 pilot accounts this week, i'll try using it in onboarding notes.
Aisha Patel: updated template suggestion — one extra line for tags and rough score.
```
Customer Nugget
- Short description (1 sentence)
- Customer impact (#customers or % of flows)
- Ask + urgency (low/med/high)
- Tags: onboarding | renewal-risk | integrations | perf
- Score: impact X / effort Y
```
Tom Nguyen: can we make a quick doc in Confluence and a tiny macro so SEs and CSMs can insert it? link would be helpful.
ProductOps Bot: Created doc draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/nugget-playbook-draft (private) — feel free to edit. :robot_face:
Ravi Kapoor: plan: 1) trial in onboarding for two accounts (Maya) 2) CS gathers 3 nuggets/week 3) ProductOps pulls weekly into a triage board with scores. If anything scores high+urgent we route to weekly PM sync.
Maya Lopez: ok i'll run it this week and post results in #customer-success. i'll include a quick screenshot of sample nuggets.
Aisha Patel: lightweight acceptance criteria for the pilot: must capture at least 6 nuggets across two accounts in 7 days, and at least one nugget should include quantifiable impact.
Tom Nguyen: add to onboarding checklist: "capture 3 customer nuggets this week". i'll update the checklist. :memo:
Ravi Kapoor: thanks all — if this works we'll fold into the CS intake playbook and add an automapper to send top-scored nuggets to the product backlog. @Aisha can you take ownership of the playbook update?
Aisha Patel: yes — i'll own the playbook update and schedule the first triage import on Friday. assigning follow-ups in the doc. :thumbsup:
OnboardBot: Note — onboarding session for AcmeRetail completed. raw notes attached. consider converting key lines into Customer Nugget format.
Tom Nguyen: thanks OnboardBot — i'll pick two lines and post formatted nuggets later today.
Ravi Kapoor: perfect. small, repeatable, and measurable — exactly what we need to improve signal-to-noise for product.
Maya Lopez: that was fast. excited to try. :sparkles:
